w3Mentions.name: Buffering
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🐗 RAID — 4 raiders (Spool, Ugly-Eyes, Ad Break, Buffering) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! The palisade's stakes take their toll as they come over the wall.

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🩸 The Ad Break mauled Orlando (-36 health) over 2 rounds. They're lucky to be breathing.

w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"

loss.line: Haven couldn't hold. On the third hungry day, people started walking — in different directions. The scattering, again.
